# Fanfarr v0.5.22

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Per-title duration bypass

Sources over fifteen minutes are rejected before downloading, and some series
keep their theme inside a long video. A toggle beside Refresh lifts the cap
for that title alone; the size cap always stays. It travels with the item
rather than the job, so a toggle flipped after queueing still applies, and
the trim editor resolves with the same flag.

## Themes now written at VBR V5

Was 192k CBR on every write. V5 averages around 130 kbps and spends its bits
where ears need them, so a 90-second theme drops from about 2.1 MB to about
1.4 with better sound than 128k CBR. One quality for cutter and normaliser
alike. New writes only -- what is on disk stays until re-applied.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
